Subject: Evaluation kickoff — proposed slots & draft agenda

Hi Priyanka — thanks again for the discovery today. Quick recap and next steps below.

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference-latency on internal query workflows by 30% while keeping hallucination rate <= 2% on clinical prompts.
- Scope: ~2M monthly tokens, mix of short chat-like queries and batch reranking jobs for search.
- Constraints: data residency (US), need for audit logs and KMS integration.

Suggested next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan walkthrough) where we will:
- Review the draft trial plan and success criteria
- Align on sample prompt set and data access for evaluations
- Run through the environment/connectivity checklist (VPC option vs hosted)

Proposed 60–90 minute slots (PT):
- Tue 20 Jul, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 21 Jul, 13:00–14:30
- Fri 23 Jul, 09:00–10:30

I attached a 1-page kickoff agenda and a rough trial plan spreadsheet to help frame the session. If none of those slots work, tell me a few windows that do and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: [eval-kickoff-agenda.pdf (pdf, 1 page)], [trial-plan-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)].

Thanks — happy to loop in Karina (solutions engineer) and Vivek for commercial/rollout questions.

Best,

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff — proposed slots & draft agenda

Monica — thanks for the detailed recap and for putting the plan together. We’re excited to get started.

Availability: Wed 21 Jul, 13:00–14:30 PT works best for our team. Please lock that slot.

Attendees from our side:
- Priyanka Rao — Head of ML Platforms (owner)
- Marco Hernandez — Security Director (will validate SOC2/KMS needs)
- Arjun Mehta — ML Engineer (day-to-day for the evaluation)

High-level success criteria we want covered in the kickoff & trial plan:
1) Latency: p95 inference under 300ms for short chat flows at peak expected concurrency (est. 40 RPS).
2) Quality: end-to-end error/hallucination rate <= 2% on the provided clinical prompt set.
3) Observability: per-request tracing and per-token cost breakdowns available within console/logs.
4) Security: KMS support and audit logs retained for 12 months.

Pre-kickoff asks:
- Can you confirm whether your hosted offering will handle our US-only data residency requirement?
- Please confirm the minimum footprint (GPUs/instances) needed for our expected load so procurement can budget.

I attached a small sample prompt file we’ll bring to the session to run initial prompt evals.

Thanks — looking forward to Wed.

—Priyanka

- Monica will run the technical deep dive and trial plan; Karina (cc’d) will cover ingestion/connectivity and any private deployment options.
